title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: memory now uses chat history, with refreshed Memory settings
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap and supplied Microsoft notice support its rollout account, and Microsoft Learn supports its licensing, default state and Graph control. The documented limits on retention, discovery and audit logging are accurately distinguished from ordinary Copilot chat governance.
